description:
⚙️ SYSTEM CONTROL: Retrieves system status, switches frameworks, manages gates, and provides analytics.

ACTIONS: status | framework | gates | analytics | config | maintenance | guide | injection | session | changes | execution_history | skills_sync

Returns: Current state, configurations, or operation confirmations.

ACTIVE FRAMEWORK [CAGEERF]: Status shows the current CAGEERF phase context.

action.description:
The operation to perform: status (runtime overview), framework (switch/enable/disable frameworks), gates (manage quality gates), analytics (usage metrics), config (read-only: list/keys/validate — writes go through the `cpm` CLI), maintenance (restart), guide (get recommendations), injection (session overrides for injected guidance), session (manage execution sessions — list/clear/inspect; cancel moved to prompt_engine), changes (resource change audit log), execution_history (chain execution ledger, newest first), skills_sync (export canonical resources to client skill packages — set operation to status|export|sync|diff|pull|clone).

ACTIVE FRAMEWORK [CAGEERF]: Use 'guide' with topic:'framework' for phase-specific operation guidance.

category.description: For skills_sync clone: target category for prompt resources. Default: general.

client.description: For skills_sync: target client id. Use one of: claude-code, cursor, codex, opencode, or all.

config.description: For config `get`: `{ operation: "get", key }` returns that key's effective value and source. For config `validate` only: `{ key, value, operation: "validate" }` checks whether `value` would be valid for `key`, without writing it. Omit `config` and set the top-level `operation` to `list` (whole loaded configuration), `keys` (declared schema keys) or `validate` (load-time schema check).

confirm.description: Required `true` for operations that replace or discard state: analytics reset and maintenance restart. Each refuses without it.

enabled.description: For injection override: `true` turns the injection on, `false` turns it off. Required.

expires_in_ms.description: For injection override: milliseconds until the override expires. Omit it to keep the override until reset.

file.description: For skills_sync clone: path to the source SKILL.md file. Required for clone.

force.description: For skills_sync clone: overwrite an existing resource directory.

framework.description: Target framework for switch operations. Use system_control(action:'framework', operation:'list') to see available frameworks.

id.description: For skills_sync: resource id filter, or for clone the id of the resource to create.

include_planned.description: For guide: set false to leave out operations marked planned. Default: true.

limit.description: Maximum entries to return, for analytics history, changes list and execution_history list.

operation.description: Sub-command for the selected action (e.g., framework switch/list/enable/disable; gates enable/disable/status/health/list; analytics view/reset/history; config list/keys/get/validate; maintenance restart; injection status/override/reset; session list/clear/inspect; changes list; execution_history list/steps; skills_sync status/export/sync/diff/pull/clone).

output.description: For skills_sync diff: write .patch files to this directory instead of stdout only.

persist.description: When true, gate/framework enable/disable changes are also written to the workspace config file (config.jsonc, or config.json if that is what exists).

preview.description: For skills_sync export/sync/pull/clone: report every file, prune and registration change the run would make, and make none of them.

preview_detail.description: For skills_sync: how much `preview` shows. `summary` (default) lists the planned changes; `diff` adds unified diffs and is valid for `pull` only, the one command that computes prose changes. Requires `preview: true` — on its own it would not be read, so it is refused by name.

prune.description: For skills_sync sync: when true (default), remove stale managed skills not present in current registrations.

reason.description: Audit reason for framework/gate toggles or admin actions.

resource_type.description: Resource type filter. skills_sync accepts prompt, gate, framework or style; changes list records prompt and gate only.

scope.description: Read by two actions with different values. skills_sync: `user` (default) or `project` client directories. injection override: `session` (default), `chain` or `step`. Each action refuses the other's values.

scope_id.description: For injection override: the chain or step id a `chain` or `step` scoped override applies to.

search_query.description: Filter gates by keyword (matches ID, name, or description). Use with gates:list action.

session_id.description: Target session ID or chain ID for session operations and for execution_history steps (the latest record of each step of that run).

show_details.description: Include detailed output (framework and session lists).

since.description: For changes list: only changes recorded since this ISO 8601 timestamp.

source.description: For changes list: only changes from this source — filesystem (a file edit hot reload detected), mcp-tool (a resource_manager write) or external (a change made while the server was down).

type.description: For injection override: the injection type to override.

name: system_control
title: System Control
